final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT races.name AS race_name, SUM(results.points) AS points_sum, AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId GROUP BY races.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(points_sum) AS avg_points FROM per_race) SELECT SUM(per_race.points_sum), AVG(per_race.avg_laps), AVG(per_race.points_sum - overall.avg_points) FROM per_race CROSS JOIN overall WHERE per_race.points_sum > overall.avg_points
